description: Expected behaviors for testing the local candidate store. These are test scenarios, not claims that external indexes are synchronized.

scenarios.name: Valid candidate publishes
scenarios.setup: Create a document and a valid candidate with non-empty normalized text and chunk source metadata.

scenarios.name: Invalid candidate must not replace active version
scenarios.setup: Create an active version and a candidate with empty normalized text or no chunks.

scenarios.name: Candidate is not active before validation
scenarios.setup: Create an active version and then prepare a candidate.

scenarios.name: Interrupted candidate build
scenarios.setup: Simulate an error before candidate publication.
